3-Day Delphi & Meteora Guided Tour from Athens
summary:
The 3-Day Delphi & Meteora Tour focuses on two of central Greece’s most important cultural sites without adding the longer Peloponnese circuit. At Delphi, explore the Sanctuary of Apollo and the archaeological remains associated with the ancient oracle before continuing north to Meteora. Here, historic monasteries built on towering rock formations reveal a very different period of Greek religious and cultural history.
Spread across three days, the route allows more time between Delphi and Meteora than a compressed day trip. The program operates year-round and includes selected 4-star hotels with breakfast, English-speaking local guides, entrance fees, transfers and scheduled sightseeing.

itinerary.title: Delphi via Thebes, Levadia and Arachova
itinerary.text: Meet in the hotel lobby and depart for Delphi via Thebes, Levadia, and Arachova. Visit the Sanctuary of Apollo, the Temple of Apollo at Delphi, and the Delphi Archaeological Museum. Overnight in Delphi.

itinerary.title: Delphi to Kalambaka
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel with free time at leisure in Delphi. Later, depart through the scenic landscapes of Central Greece, passing through Lamia on the way to Kalambaka, the charming town located at the foot of the spectacular Meteora rock formations. Overnight in Kalambaka.

itinerary.title: Visit Meteora and Return to Athens
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Visit Meteora and its famous monasteries built on towering rock formations. Return to Athens via Trikala, Lamia, and Thermopylae with a stop at the Leonidas Monument. Arrival in Athens around 18:30–19:00. Accommodation in Athens before or after the tour is not included.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 3-Day Delphi & Meteora Tour?
faqs.a: The 3-Day Delphi & Meteora Tour covers Delphi, Meteora, and Kalambaka. You will explore the ancient Sanctuary of Apollo at Delphi, visit the spectacular monasteries of Meteora perched atop towering rock formations, and stay in the charming town of Kalambaka. The tour runs for 2 nights and 3 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 3-Day Delphi & Meteora Tour cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €595 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, guided sightseeing tours, entrance fees according to the itinerary, selected meals, transportation between destinations, and hotel transfers. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates and hotel availability.

faqs.q: What are the main attractions included in the tour?
faqs.a: The tour includes the archaeological site of Delphi, the Sanctuary of Apollo, the Delphi Archaeological Museum, the world-famous Meteora monasteries, and the dramatic rock formations that make Meteora one of Greece's most remarkable UNESCO World Heritage Sites.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes 2 nights at carefully selected hotels with daily breakfast. Hotels are chosen for their comfort, service quality, and convenient locations, particularly in the Kalambaka area near Meteora.

faqs.q: Does the 3-Day Delphi & Meteora Tour include a guide?
faqs.a: Yes, professional English-speaking guides are included during the scheduled sightseeing tours. Your guides provide historical insights, cultural information, and local expertise throughout the journey.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Greece?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors interested in Greece's history, culture, and natural beauty. It combines one of the country's most important archaeological sites with one of its most breathtaking landscapes and religious landmarks.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through archaeological sites and climbing stairs at the Meteora monasteries. Some areas have uneven surfaces, but most travelers with average fitness levels can comfortably participate.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of Delphi and Meteora?
faqs.a: Delphi was considered the spiritual center of the ancient Greek world and is home to the famous Oracle of Apollo. Meteora is renowned for its extraordinary monasteries built on towering rock pillars, offering stunning scenery, remarkable architecture, and unique cultural heritage.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the Delphi & Meteora Tour?
faqs.a: You can cancel free of charge up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 30 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Is the 3-Day Delphi & Meteora Tour available all year and can it be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour operates throughout the year and can be customized according to your preferences. You can add extra nights, upgrade hotel categories, combine the tour with Athens or the Greek Islands, or modify the itinerary. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
